definitions.explanation: The age at which a person is considered old enough for romance or marriage, or the age of puberty and adolescence when one becomes self-conscious.
Used to indicate an approximate age or the age at which something typically happens.

examples.japanese: {年頃|としごろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I have a daughter of marriageable age.

examples.japanese: {年頃|としごろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{外見|がいけん}→外見：12114_gaiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧にし{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: When you reach that age, you start caring about your appearance.

examples.japanese: {年頃|としごろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{子|こ}ども⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}したがらない→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ものだ。
examples.english: Adolescents tend not to want to talk to their parents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{年頃|としごろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ばせたい→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: I want to let them play with children around the same age.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの{方|かた}→あの方：16618_anokata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{五十|ごじゅう}→五十：00930_gojuu⟧⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧{年頃|としごろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: That person looks to be around fifty years old.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧{年頃|としごろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧だ。
examples.english: It's an area with many children of school-starting age.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is the most common usage, often referring to teenage or young adult years when someone becomes interested in romance. When parents say their child is {年頃|としごろ}, it often implies the child is entering puberty or becoming self-conscious. Sense 2 is more neutral, simply indicating an approximate age.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年頃|としごろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧ (daughter of marriageable age)
- ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{年頃|としごろ} (around the same age)
- {年頃|としごろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{子|こ}ども (adolescent child)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧: age — neutral, factual term
- ⟦{適齢期|てきれいき}→適齢期：17219_tekireiki⟧: appropriate age (especially for marriage) — more direct
